versions.changelog:
- Added new LLM Arbiter check module (`scripts/checks/llm_arbiter.py`) to enhance audit coverage.
- Updated core scripts for protocol and runtime security analysis.
- Revised and expanded security rules in JSON configuration files.
- Removed outdated documentation file (`skill-card.md`).
- General improvements and maintenance to support new checks and ensure up-to-date coverage.

- Added stricter path and execution safety: all commands must use the absolute skill installation path (AUDIT_DIR) to prevent script hijacking in untrusted directories.
- Updated internal rule sets: SkillSpector now uses 52 rules across 18 categories and gitleaks uses 43 rules.
- Disabled auto-discovery of external skill check binaries on PATH; only explicitly specified binaries can be used for checks.
- Enhanced documentation to clarify security requirements, scan level semantics, and differences between rule attributes and scan modes.
- Removed support for the relative or in-directory execution—absolute path invocation is now enforced for all commands.
- Removed old/legacy documentation (skill-card.md) for clarity and deprecated usage patterns.

- Added CLI support with new scripts: scripts/cli/cli_entry.py and scripts/cli/cli_reporting.py.
- Updated internal logic in scripts/checks/skillspector_builtin_check.py and scripts/install_cli.sh.
- Removed redundant documentation file: skill-card.md.
